h1: Custom Crystal Candles for Branded Gifts
metaDescription: Order custom crystal candles for your next event. Perfect for corporate gifts and promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Crystal candles offer a refined look that sets them apart from standard wax candles. The clear, glass-like material showcases the wax color and any embedded logo or design, making them ideal for upscale corporate gifts or event favors. Whether you choose a frosted or polished finish, these candles provide a clean, modern aesthetic that suits any brand. Decorate with screen printing or etching for a lasting impression.
heroAltText: Custom crystal candles with etched logo on clear glass, perfect for corporate gifts
